title: Builder Control — Weekly AI Scout JSON Sidecar + Diff
description: JSON sidecar for the existing DANIEL Monday markdown scout (research/daniel-tool-scout-YYYY-MM-DD.md). The scout itself is NOT rebuilt; B3 emits this sidecar by parsing the latest markdown plus a diff vs the prior week so a downstream consumer sees only 'what changed how Marc builds' — verdict changes, substrate changes, watchlist promotions/expirations. Written next to the markdown as research/daniel-tool-scout-YYYY-MM-DD.json.

bluf.description: Bottom-line-up-front, copied from the markdown BLUF section.

verdict.description: The AI Ops Research Desk capability-harvest verdict.

buildRelevance.description: ONE line: does this change how Marc builds? (substrate swap candidate, watch-only, market context, etc.)

differentiatorVsCurrent.description: How it compares to what Marc currently uses.

diffVsPrior.description: The actionable delta — the whole point of the sidecar.

newItems.description: Item names present this week, absent last week.

substrateChanges.description: Changes to the build substrate (model / orchestration / voice-path / metering) Marc should act on.

examples.bluf: One in-window enterprise voice-AI partnership signal; no foundation-model changes; substrate watchlist unchanged.

items.name: ElevenLabs ElevenAgents x TELUS Digital
items.buildRelevance: Market-maturity signal — governed enterprise voice tier now exists; not a swap candidate for a solo advisor.
items.differentiatorVsCurrent: Marc's tracked voice path is Retell AI (solo-deployable, per-minute); ElevenAgents-via-TELUS is enterprise-CX, white-glove.

substrateChanges: Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 on Bedrock — still highest-leverage substrate item; regression-test before any fleet swap (unchanged this week).
